trajectory_summary: This is a low-friction, inbound-energy call: the customer called back already interested, moved through verify cleanly, and booked an appointment for the next day. The main soft spots are a channel-clarity gap (customer didn't realize it was an in-person visit until after committing to a time) and an unresolved bill-email technical failure that was never closed out or clearly handed off. The call ends with a booked appointment but a missing verbal handshake and no confirmation the bill actually arrived.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag is unknown/unclear; based on the transcript this is a booked appointment (day + time both stated) but with two structural weaknesses — the bill was never confirmed received, and there was no 'is that fair' handshake per button_up.is_that_fair_handshake — that make it a fragile booked outcome rather than a clean one.
